function.name: maps_route_times
function.description: Estimates the time it will take to travel from one location to another by a specific mode of transportation. Unlike maps_shortest_path, which finds the shortest path, this estimates the travel time.

route.description: The string representation of the route.

mode.description: The mode of transportation (walk, bike, transit, drive).

function.name: maps_shortest_path
function.description: Find the shortest path from one location to another by using a specific mode of transportation. Unlike maps_route_times, which estimates the travel time, this finds the shortest path.

start_location.description: The name or coordinates of the start location.

end_location.description: The name or coordinates of the end location.

mode.description: The mode of transportation (walk, bike, transit, drive).
